_noteP: P (Silver Stake, verified via leagueoflegends.com/en-us/champions/locke/): Locke's basic attacks deal additional magic damage on-hit, increased based on the target's missing health. LockePassive (hashed key {7531bb00}) defines two calcs: 'MinOnHitDamage' (ByCharLevelInterpolationCalculationPart(5..40) + StatByCoefficientCalculationPart(0.1)) applied when target is ABOVE 30% HP, and 'MaxOnHitDamage' (ByCharLevelInterpolationCalculationPart(10..80) + StatByCoefficientCalculationPart(0.2)) applied at/below 30% HP (gated by AboveHealthPercentCastRequirement/mCurrentPercentHealth=0.3, mInvertResult). Both CalculationPart kinds used are fully supported by FormulaInterpreter. The HP-threshold branch itself is not modeled (no engine support for conditional calc selection), so this is curated as a flat P bonusEffect trigger onHit using the baseline MinOnHitDamage (the common case, target above 30% HP); the higher MaxOnHitDamage tier near execute range is NOT captured -- flag if precision near low-HP targets matters. Tagged PercentMissingHp: real damage continuously ramps up to 2x based on the target's missing health; this curation is the floor (0% missing-HP) value only.

_noteQStacks: Q NAIL CONSUMPTION, TIERED (loop 484 - the user supplied the shape: base, then (base x 2) x 1.2 at two nails and (base x 3) x 1.4 at three). Loop 483 left this open because writing 2.4x and 4.2x into a data file means writing DERIVED constants that go silently wrong when a balance patch moves either percentage. Stated as count-times-percentage it needs no constants at all: the count is structural (three nails, and the tier list says so by its own length) and both percentages are BIN DataValues, TwoMarkBonusPercent 20 and ThreeMarkBonusPercent 40. Curated through the new stackTierBonusDataValues field, which lands NailDamage N times and raises it by the Nth tier. Checks against the live wiki (fetched 2026-08-21): 18/26/34/42/50 at one nail, 43.2/62.4/81.6/100.8/120 at two, 75.6/109.2/142.8/176.4/210 at three - exactly 1x, 2.4x and 4.2x. The mechanic itself: Soul Nails stack to 3 on a target for 4 seconds, and Lockes next damaging basic attack OR Ashen Pursuit consumes them ALL at once, which is why this is one rider capped at one proc rather than a per-nail effect. The nail count is the nodes stack knob, bounded to 1-3 by the tier list; leaving it alone resolves ONE nail, which is exactly what this rider scored before the field existed.
